job.title: Project manager
job.description:
Project Manager – High-End Residential

Eastern Suburbs | Projects up to $15M | $180K + Super | Monday–Friday

The Opportunity We are currently seeking an experienced Project Manager to join a well-established construction business delivering high-end residential projects throughout Sydney’s Eastern Suburbs.
With projects valued up to $15M, this is an opportunity to take ownership of quality-driven projects and work alongside an experienced team delivering premium construction outcomes.

Monday to Friday | Up to $180K + Super
About the Role As Project Manager, you will be responsible for the successful delivery of projects from construction through to completion, managing programme, cost, quality, subcontractors and client expectations.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Managing high-end residential projects valued up to $15M
  • Leading projects from commencement through to practical completion and handover
  • Managing project programmes, budgets, procurement and variations
  • Coordinating subcontractors, consultants, architects and engineers
  • Managing client relationships and project expectations
  • Ensuring quality, safety and programme targets are achieved
  • Managing project documentation, reporting and project controls
  • Identifying and resolving construction issues proactively
  • Using Procore to manage project documentation, communication and workflows
  • Working closely with site teams to ensure projects are delivered to a high standard
About You We are looking for a Project Manager who is confident managing complex construction projects and has a strong understanding of the delivery process.
You must have:
  • Proven Project Management experience within the construction industry
  • Strong Procore experience – essential
  • Experience managing projects up to $15M
  • Excellent knowledge of construction programmes, budgets and subcontractor management
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • A high level of attention to detail and organisation
Your background:
  • Ideally, you will have experience delivering high-end residential projects
  • We are also open to candidates coming from a strong Class 2 construction background
  • Experience with premium finishes, detailed construction and quality-driven projects will be highly regarded
What's on Offer
  • Salary up to $180K + Super, depending on experience
  • Monday–Friday working week
  • High-end residential projects across Sydney's Eastern Suburbs
  • Project values up to $15M
  • Opportunity to work on premium, architecturally designed projects
  • Strong pipeline of upcoming projects
  • Long-term career opportunity with an established construction business
Apply Now If you're an experienced Project Manager with Procore experience and are looking for your next opportunity in high-end residential or Class 2 construction, we'd like to hear from you. Email Tara on trogers@designandbuild.com.au

job.title: Accountant | Construction
job.description:
Accountant | Western Sydney | Construction

We are currently seeking an experienced Accountant to join a well-established project-based business in Western Sydney.

This is a hands-on accounting role focused specifically on project accounting, WIP, forecasting and month-end reporting. Working closely with the Finance Manager, you’ll play an important role in supporting the financial management of a busy construction operation.

The Role
  • Prepare and maintain accurate WIP reporting across construction projects
  • Assist with forecasting, budgeting and financial analysis
  • Prepare and support month-end reporting and reconciliations
  • Assist with accounts receivable and project-related invoicing
  • Manage and process progress claims and project invoices
  • Upload new projects and relevant financial information into internal systems
  • Monitor project financials and assist with identifying variances
  • Provide day-to-day accounting support to the Finance Manager
  • Work closely with project and operational teams to ensure financial information is accurate and up to date
About You

We’re looking for a construction-focused Accountant who understands the financial side of project-based environments and is comfortable working closely with project teams.

You will ideally have:
  • Previous accounting experience within construction, building or infrastructure
  • Strong experience with WIP, forecasting and project accounting
  • Experience with month-end reporting and financial analysis
  • Exposure to progress claims, invoicing and accounts receivable
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to work with large volumes of project data
  • The ability to work independently while providing strong support to the Finance Manager
  • Experience with a Tier 1/Tier 2 construction business or similar project environment would be highly regarded
This is not a generalist accounting role focused on BAS, tax and ATO compliance. The position is specifically focused on project and construction accounting, supporting the Finance Manager and ensuring the financial performance of projects is accurately reported and managed.

job.title: State Manager
job.description:
Design & Build is looking for a proven recruitment leader to take ownership of our WA business and lead its next stage of growth.

This is not a turnaround role.

You will inherit a healthy six-person team, an established client base, a recognised national brand and a Perth business that has grown year on year since launching in 2021.

The opportunity is to build on that foundation and establish one of WA’s leading specialist recruitment businesses.

The opportunity

This is a billing State Manager position, combining leadership of the WA team with continued ownership of a specialist recruitment market.

Energy & Resources is a significant growth opportunity for the business, but we are open to shaping the desk around the experience, relationships and market knowledge of the right person.

You will lead from the front by developing clients, building your market, billing personally and helping the team perform and grow. Once the WA business reaches 12 people, your personal billing responsibilities will transition out, allowing you to focus fully on leadership, strategy and continued expansion.

You will report directly to Andrew McGregor, Managing Director, with the autonomy and support to shape the future of the WA business.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Leading, coaching and developing the existing WA team
  • Building a high-performing specialist recruitment market
  • Growing relationships with clients across WA
  • Attracting experienced recruiters into the business
  • Setting clear standards around activity, performance and accountability
  • Identifying new markets and growth opportunities
  • Protecting and strengthening the culture as the team scales
  • Taking ownership of the WA strategy and P&L
Who we are looking for

Energy & Resources recruitment experience would be highly regarded, but it is not essential.

More important is a strong understanding of the WA market, a proven ability to build lasting client relationships and established credibility within a specialist recruitment sector.

We are open to leaders from Energy, Resources, Construction, Engineering, Infrastructure, Property or other related technical markets.

You may already be operating at State Manager level, or you may be a successful Team Leader or Manager who is ready to take the next step.

You will bring:
  • A strong background in specialist recruitment within the WA market
  • At least one to two years’ experience leading a small team
  • A proven personal billing track record
  • The ability to win work and build lasting client relationships
  • A genuine interest in developing people and growing a business
  • A leadership style aligned with our values of Honest Communication, Focus, Feedback and Care
Why Design & Build?

Design & Build has been operating for more than 20 years, with offices in Perth, Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane.

Our vision is to become Australia’s most trusted recruitment agency. We measure ourselves against a simple mission: doing right by our clients, candidates, colleagues and community.

You will also receive:
  • A 35-hour working week with flexibility around start and finish times
  • Two work-from-home days each week
  • A fully paid Christmas shutdown in addition to annual leave
  • An additional day of leave for every year of service, providing up to 30 days of annual leave after five years
  • An annual all-expenses-paid High Achievers trip
  • Structured leadership development and ongoing coaching
  • Free and unlimited access to Sonder’s 24/7 wellbeing and safety support
  • Enhanced parental and compassionate leave
  • Support from experienced national leaders across operations, finance, people and culture, learning and development, and marketing
This is a genuine opportunity to inherit a strong platform, lead an established team and build a substantial WA recruitment business.

If you are an experienced recruitment leader ready to take ownership of a state and shape its next stage of growth, we would like to hear from you.

Apply confidentially or contact Andrew McGregor for a direct conversation.

job.title: National Corporate Account Manager | Workspaces
job.description:
Strategic National Accounts | Property & Workplace Solutions | Senior Client Relationships

The Company
Our client is a well-established Australian organisation operating across the commercial property, workplace and construction sectors. With a strong national presence and broad suite of solutions, they partner with some of Australia’s largest corporate organisations to deliver innovative workplace outcomes.

An opportunity now exists for an experienced National Corporate Account Manager to join their established national team and take ownership of strategic relationships with major enterprise clients.

The Opportunity
This is not a traditional project-based sales role. You’ll focus on building long-term, national relationships with major corporate end users, working with senior decision-makers across Property, Workplace, Facilities, Procurement, Design and Executive teams.

You will manage and grow existing strategic accounts while also identifying and securing new national clients, particularly large organisations operating across multiple states and locations. The focus is on getting ahead of upcoming projects, understanding clients’ longer-term workplace strategies and positioning solutions before opportunities formally come to market.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Develop and execute strategic growth plans across major national accounts
  • Build relationships with senior and C-Suite stakeholders across large corporate organisations
  • Grow existing accounts while proactively targeting new national clients
  • Identify future opportunities, workplace initiatives and client needs before projects hit the market
  • Negotiate national agreements, preferred supplier arrangements and commercial frameworks
  • Work closely with state-based sales teams to deliver a consistent national approach
  • Identify opportunities to cross-sell a broader range of workplace products and solutions
  • Maintain a strong pipeline and drive sustainable, long-term revenue growth
About You
We’re looking for a commercially minded relationship builder who understands how to navigate large, complex corporate accounts at a national level.
You will ideally bring:
  • 5+ years’ experience in national account management, business development or strategic sales
  • A strong existing network of national corporate relationships and decision-makers is key
  • Experience across workplace, commercial furniture, property, construction, property services or a related B2B environment
  • Demonstrated experience developing and growing major enterprise accounts
  • Confidence engaging with senior executives and C-Suite stakeholders
  • A strategic approach to sales – someone who can look beyond the immediate project and identify longer-term opportunities
  • Strong commercial, communication and stakeholder management skills.
This is an excellent opportunity for an established national sales professional looking to take ownership of significant corporate relationships and play a key role in the continued growth of a leading Australian business.

For any questions relating to this role or other opportunities with D&B and our clients please contact Renee Hamilton at rhamilton@designandbuild.com.au or click apply. Your application will be treated as strictly confidential.

job.title: Quality Systems Leader - Architecture & Design
job.description:
I’m currently working with a highly regarded, award-winning design practice that is looking to appoint a Quality Systems Leader to take ownership of their Quality Management System and help drive a strong culture of quality across the business.

This is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong background in quality systems and architecture/design who enjoys working collaboratively with technical teams and influencing how quality is embedded into everyday project delivery.

The Role You’ll be responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the organisation’s Quality Management System, ensuring ongoing ISO 9001 compliance while working closely with teams across the business.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Maintaining and improving the ISO 9001 Quality Management System and ensuring ongoing compliance.
  • Developing and maintaining practice standards, processes, templates and quality documentation.
  • Improving the quality, consistency and coordination of project documentation.
  • Reviewing and analysing client feedback to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement.
  • Driving continuous improvement initiatives across the business.
  • Working closely with project and technical teams to embed quality into everyday processes.
  • Supporting teams with quality requirements, systems and best practice.
  • Providing guidance and training to help build a shared responsibility for quality across the practice.
  • Identifying opportunities to use technology and innovation to improve quality processes and outcomes.
What We're Looking For We’re looking for someone who brings:
  • Strong knowledge and practical experience with ISO 9001 and Quality Management Systems.
  • Previous experience within architecture and/or design is essential.
  • A background in a technical, quality or project delivery environment.
  • Strong understanding of documentation standards, coordination and project delivery processes.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong organisation and attention to detail.
  • The ability to train, guide and support technical teams.
  • A proactive approach to continuous improvement and risk reduction.
  • An interest in using technology and innovation to improve quality systems.
Why Consider It?
  • Join an award-winning, design-led practice with a strong national reputation.
  • Take genuine ownership of the organisation's quality systems and continuous improvement strategy.
  • Work across a diverse range of major projects and technical teams.
  • A role with strong visibility and the opportunity to influence how quality is delivered across the business.
  • Flexible working options and a genuine focus on wellbeing and work-life balance.
  • Access to mentoring, professional development and clear career progression.
  • Be part of a collaborative environment where quality, creativity and new ideas are encouraged.
If you're a quality or technical leader with an architecture/design background and you're looking for a role where you can have a genuine impact on systems, processes and project delivery, I'd love to hear from you.

job.title: HR & Industrial Relations Professionals | Multiple FIFO Opportunities
job.description:
HR & Industrial Relations Professionals | Multiple FIFO Opportunities
Officer | Advisor | Senior Advisor

Ready to take your HR or Industrial Relations career to the next level?

We're partnering with a leading organisation delivering one of Australia's most iconic and complex infrastructure projects and are seeking multiple HR and Industrial Relations professionals across Officer, Advisor and Senior Advisor level.

These FIFO positions offer the rare opportunity to work on a nationally significant project, partnering closely with operational leaders and a diverse workforce while gaining exposure to complex people, employee relations and industrial relations matters in a fast-paced construction environment.
Whether your expertise is in Human Resources, Industrial Relations or a combination of both, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Roles Working within an experienced People & Culture team, you'll provide practical HR and / OR IR support across a major project. Depending on your experience, your responsibilities may include:
  • Providing HR and/or IR advice to managers and employees across a large blue and white-collar workforce.
  • Interpreting and applying employment legislation, Awards and Enterprise Agreements.
  • Supporting employee relations matters including performance management, misconduct, disciplinary processes and workplace investigations.
  • Managing industrial relations matters, workplace compliance and stakeholder engagement.
  • Preparing employment contracts, correspondence and HR documentation.
  • Supporting workforce mobilisation, onboarding and HR administration activities.
  • Partnering with leaders to deliver practical people solutions and coaching.
  • Assisting with HR initiatives, culture programs and continuous improvement projects.
  • Delivering HR and IR training to leaders and employees.
  • Building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support successful project outcomes.
About You To be successful, you'll bring:
  • Experience in Human Resources, Industrial Relations or Employee Relations.
  • Sound knowledge of Australian employment legislation, including the Fair Work Act.
  • Experience interpreting Awards and Enterprise Agreements (highly regarded).
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • A proactive, collaborative and solutions-focused approach.
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in Human Resources, Employment Relations, Business, Law or a related discipline will be highly regarded.
Experience within construction, infrastructure, mining, engineering or other project-based environments will be highly regarded but is not essential.
What's on Offer
  • FIFO roster with accommodation, meals and travel provided.
  • The opportunity to contribute to one of Australia's landmark infrastructure projects.
  • Multiple opportunities available across Officer, Advisor and Senior Advisor level.
  • Exposure to complex HR and Industrial Relations matters within a large-scale project environment.
  • Work alongside experienced HR and IR professionals in a collaborative and supportive team.
  • Excellent career development and progression opportunities.
  • Competitive salary packages aligned with experience.
If you're looking for a career-defining opportunity where you can make a genuine impact on a nationally significant project, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact Renee Hamilton at Design & Build Recruitment for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Foreman
job.description:
Working Foreman – Luxury Residential Construction Eastern Suburbs | Projects up to $3M | $125K+ Super
We are looking for an experienced Working Foreman to join our team and take a hands-on leadership role across a range of high-end residential projects in Sydney’s Eastern Suburbs.

  • Read and interpret plans, specifications and construction documentation

  • Liaise with project managers, clients, architects and consultants

  • Has solid experience as a Foreman or Working Foreman
  • Has proven experience delivering luxury/high-end residential projects
  • Has experience working on projects valued up to $3M
  • Can confidently run and coordinate a team of subcontractors and carpenters
  • Has strong knowledge of residential construction from start to finish
  • Takes pride in quality workmanship and presentation
  • Is organised, reliable and proactive
  • Can communicate effectively with trades, management and clients
  • Has a strong understanding of site safety and construction requirements
  • Is comfortable being hands-on and leading from the front
What’s On Offer
  • Salary up to $125,000 + Super, depending on experience
  • High-end residential projects throughout Sydney’s Eastern Suburbs
  • Stable pipeline of quality projects
  • Supportive and professional team environment
  • Opportunity to take ownership of projects and progress within the business
If you're an experienced residential Foreman who takes pride in delivering high-quality luxury homes and can confidently lead a site team, we'd like to hear from you. Email Tara on trogers@designandbuild.com.au

job.title: National Government Account Manager | Workplace Solutions
job.description:
Strategic Federal Government Accounts | National Role | Workplace Solutions

The Company
Our client is a long-established Australian organisation with a strong national presence, delivering high-quality workplace products and solutions to major organisations across Australia.

Due to continued growth, they are seeking an experienced National Account Manager – Federal Government to take ownership of strategic government relationships and drive long-term growth across the sector.

The Opportunity
This is a senior, strategic relationship role focused on building and growing relationships across Federal Government.

Rather than transactional or project-by-project sales, you’ll take a longer-term approach – understanding clients' national property and workplace portfolios, developing multi-year account strategies and identifying opportunities well before they formally come to market.

You’ll work with senior stakeholders across Property, Workplace, Facilities, Procurement, Design, People & Culture and Executive teams, while partnering with internal state-based teams to deliver a coordinated national approach.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Own and develop strategic relationships across key Federal Government accounts
  • Develop 1–3-year account and growth strategies
  • Protect and grow existing relationships while identifying new Federal Government opportunities
  • Build relationships with senior government decision-makers and influencers
  • Understand clients' national workplace and property strategies to identify future opportunities
  • Grow share of wallet across existing accounts
  • Develop and negotiate national agreements, rates and preferred supplier arrangements
  • Identify opportunities to introduce additional workplace products and solutions
  • Work closely with state sales teams to deliver a consistent national client experience
  • Maintain visibility of pipeline, account activity and future opportunities
  • Support major tenders and national procurement opportunities.
About You
This role requires someone who already knows the Federal Government market. You will bring established relationships and understand how to navigate complex government stakeholder and procurement environments.
Ideally, you will have:
  • An existing network/black book of Federal Government contacts
  • 5+ years' relevant sales, business development or account management experience at Federal Government level
  • Experience managing large, complex and strategic accounts
  • Strong relationships across government Property, Workplace, Facilities and/or Procurement functions
  • A track record of both growing existing accounts and developing new relationships
  • Experience developing long-term account strategies rather than simply pursuing individual projects
  • Strong commercial and stakeholder management capability
  • Confidence engaging with senior decision-makers
  • A strategic, relationship-led approach to business development
Previous experience introducing new products or solutions to market will also be highly regarded.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an established Federal Government account professional to take ownership of a significant national portfolio and build long-term relationships within an established Australian organisation.

For any questions relating to this role or other opportunities with D&B and our clients please contact Renee Hamilton at rhamilton@designandbuild.com.au or click apply. Your application will be treated as strictly confidential

job.description:

What You’ll Bring
  • Strong estimating experience within residential construction
  • High attention to detail and confidence working on bespoke projects
  • Motivation to succeed, learn and grow within a tight‑knit team
  • Ability to work closely with senior leadership and take ownership
  • A proactive mindset and genuine drive to deliver quality outcomes
Why This Role Stands Out
  • Work directly with a highly respected Director

  • Salary up to $150k + super depending on experience

job.title: Estimating Manager

About the Company
A well-established residential building business based in Hamilton, Brisbane, is looking for an experienced Estimating Manager to take ownership of its estimating program.

Estimating sits at the centre of the business, with projects priced from in-house designs, quantity take-offs, supplier and trade rates. The business operates through a fully integrated Databuild and Onsite Companion workflow system.

About the Role
As the Estimating Manager, you will take ownership of the estimating program while remaining hands-on with the day-to-day estimating function.
You will prepare take-offs, budgets and estimates, manage supplier and trade pricing, identify cost-saving opportunities and lead and mentor the estimating team.

Reporting directly to the Managing Director, you will work closely with the construction, operations and product development teams to ensure projects are accurately priced, cost-effective and aligned with the company's objectives.
This is a key role for someone who is committed, reliable and enthusiastic, with a strong focus on accuracy, efficiency, profitability and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities
  • Operate and maintain the integrated Databuild system, including cost codes, catalogues and pricing databases.
  • Maintain the flow of data between Databuild and Onsite Companion.
  • Prepare and review accurate quantity take-offs, bills of quantities and Job Analysis Reports.
  • Conduct technical plan reviews at both Preliminary Plans and Working Drawings stages.
  • Prepare detailed cost estimates for customer proposals, factoring in general and special conditions.
  • Ensure sales estimates meet required budgets and deadlines.
  • Develop scopes of works for external stakeholders.
  • Review supplier and subcontractor quotations and negotiate pricing to identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Prepare project budgets for management approval and monitor actual costs against budget.
  • Report on project progress, costs and profitability to management.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and subcontractors.
  • Ensure subcontractor licences and insurances are current and accurately recorded in Onsite Companion.
  • Lead, mentor and support the estimating team.
  • Assist with internal projects and business initiatives as required.
About You To be successful in this role, you will have:
  • 5+ years' experience in construction estimating, ideally within residential building.
  • Strong, hands-on experience with Databuild, including operation, administration and maintaining pricing databases and cost codes.
  • Strong knowledge of cost estimation, bills of quantities and material take-offs.
  • Experience conducting technical plan reviews at Preliminary Plans and Working Drawings stages.
  • Experience preparing detailed budgets and analysing supplier and subcontractor quotations.
  • Strong understanding of subcontractor compliance, including licensing and insurance requirements.
  • Excellent negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • A highly analytical, organised and detail-oriented approach.
  • The ability to identify cost savings without compromising quality.
  • A proactive and results-driven approach, with a focus on process improvement.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities.
  • Relevant qualifications in construction management, quantity surveying or estimating, or equivalent industry experience.
Our Systems Hands-on Databuild experience is essential. The successful candidate will be trained on the other systems where required.
  • Databuild – Construction estimating, job costing and accounting.
  • Onsite Companion – Site and project management, linked with Databuild.
  • Therefore – Document management and invoice approval workflow.
The Opportunity This is an opportunity to step into a key position within a growing residential building business and have genuine ownership over the estimating function.

You will have the opportunity to lead an established estimating team, work directly with the Managing Director and contribute to improving systems, processes and profitability across the business.

If you are an experienced residential estimator with strong Databuild experience and are ready to take the next step into an Estimating Manager position, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now with your CV, or contact us for a confidential discussion.

This is a hands-on role suited to a mechanically strong maintenance professional who enjoys fault finding, preventative maintenance and improving the reliability of production equipment, while working within a highly regulated cGMP environment.

You will be involved across day-to-day maintenance, breakdown response, contractor coordination, compliance and continuous improvement initiatives.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Complete planned preventative maintenance, inspections, repairs and breakdown response

  • Ensure all maintenance and contractor activities are completed in line with WHS and site safety requirements
What We're Looking For We're looking for a practical, technically capable maintenance professional with strong fault-finding skills and experience working within a manufacturing environment.
Ideally, you will have:
  • A trade or tertiary qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronic Engineering or a related discipline
  • Relevant maintenance experience within a manufacturing environment
  • Strong mechanical maintenance and fault-finding capability
  • Experience with preventative maintenance and CMMS systems
  • Experience working with manufacturing equipment and critical utilities
  • Knowledge of WHS, isolation, permits, contractor management and risk assessment
  • Ability to read technical drawings, manuals and equipment documentation
  • Strong communication, organisation and problem-solving skills
  • Appropriate electrical licences/authorisations where required
  • Pharmaceutical or other regulated manufacturing experience is highly regarded
  • Exposure to cGMP, calibration, validation and change control is desirable
Why Consider the Opportunity? This is an excellent opportunity for a Maintenance Engineer looking to take on a broad, hands-on engineering position within a regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environment.
You'll have exposure to production equipment, critical utilities, reliability improvement, compliance, validation and engineering projects, making this a role with genuine technical variety.

Reporting to: Operations Manager
Employment: Permanent

job.title: Senior Project Manager - Government & Community Projects
job.description:
Melbourne | Permanent 

An established and growing majority Indigenous-owned construction business is looking for an experienced Project Manager / Senior Project Manager to join their Melbourne team.

With a strong pipeline of government-funded work, the business delivers complex projects across Defence, education, health, emergency services and civil infrastructure. The company operates with the capability and systems of a Tier 1 environment while maintaining the culture, autonomy and agility of a standalone business.

The Role
This is an opportunity for a seasoned Project Manager to take ownership of multiple projects while providing guidance to a relatively young delivery team.

You will be responsible for the full project lifecycle, with a strong focus on programming, commercial management and contractual administration, as well as project delivery. Working within a lean team of PM, CA and Site Manager, you will need to be comfortable understanding the detail behind the contract, reviewing clauses, forecasting, managing payment applications and maintaining commercial control.

You will also work closely with the Construction Manager and have the opportunity to become increasingly involved in client relationships and business development.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage projects from pre-construction through to completion
  • Develop and manage detailed project programs using MS Project
  • Oversee project budgets, forecasting, variations and payment applications
  • Review and manage contractual obligations, clauses and project risks
  • Coordinate consultants, subcontractors and project stakeholders
  • Provide leadership, guidance and mentoring to junior team members
  • Manage multiple complex projects with potentially fast turnaround times
  • Build strong relationships with clients and subcontractors
  • Work closely with the Construction Manager on delivery and strategy
  • Develop client relationships and contribute to future business development
Current Projects
The business has a strong pipeline of government and community projects, including:
  • $9M regional Victorian school project 
  • Victorian SES / emergency services projects
  • Aboriginal Youth Centre 
  • Further Defence, education, health and civil infrastructure opportunities across Victoria and interstate
The role is Melbourne-based, with regional travel every few weeks, generally for a few days at a time.

About You
You will be an experienced Project Manager who can operate with a high level of autonomy and bring maturity and commercial understanding to the team.
You will ideally have:
  • Strong experience delivering commercial, government, education, health, Defence or community projects
  • Excellent programming capability
  • Strong contract administration and commercial knowledge
  • Experience with forecasting, payment claims, variations and contractual obligations
  • The confidence to manage subcontractors and consultants
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • The ability to mentor and support less experienced team members
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach
  • The confidence to eventually contribute to business development
Experience with MS Project, Procore, HammerTech, VisiBuild or similar systems would be advantageous.

The Opportunity

The business genuinely values work-life balance, with rare Saturday work, standard office hours, occasional WFH flexibility and the ability to accommodate commitments such as school pick-up.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced PM who wants to step into a role where they can have a genuine impact — leading projects, mentoring a team and helping shape the continued growth of an established construction business.

Interested?

job.title: Pre Construction Manager
job.description:
Pre-Construction Manager
Melbourne, VIC | Permanent Full-Time
 
The Opportunity
Design & Build Recruitment is partnering with a well-established and growing electrical services contractor to appoint an experienced Pre-Construction Manager.
This is a key leadership position sitting at the intersection of Estimating, Design and Operations, taking ownership of projects from early contractor involvement and tender stage through to procurement, delivery planning and operational handover.
 
The role will suit an experienced Project Manager, Senior Estimator, Pre-Construction Manager or Engineer who understands the realities of delivering complex construction projects and enjoys influencing outcomes before construction begins.
With a strong pipeline of major projects and continued business growth, this position offers the opportunity to establish and develop a dedicated pre-construction function, with the expectation that the successful candidate will eventually lead a team.
 
The Role
As Pre-Construction Manager, you will play a critical role in ensuring projects transition effectively from concept and tender through to delivery.
Working closely with senior leadership, estimators, designers and project delivery teams, you will lead ECI and bid opportunities, review major project estimates, identify commercial and technical risks, and develop operational budgets and production metrics ahead of project commencement.
You will remain involved through early design and procurement, ensuring a structured and commercially robust handover into operations.
 
Key Responsibilities
Tender & Estimating
  • Lead and coordinate ECI and major bid opportunities alongside estimating and design teams.
  • Review significant project estimates through to final negotiation stages.
  • Provide input into buildability, constructability and design reviews.
  • Support labour rate build-ups, schedules of rates and standardised estimating information.
  • Provide technical and commercial advice around client budgets, design and project strategy.
  • Support business development activity and major tender opportunities.
Pre-Construction & Project Planning
  • Translate awarded project estimates into operational budgets and production metrics.
  • Undertake detailed reviews of project scope, design and documentation ahead of delivery.
  • Establish and manage project Risk & Opportunity registers.
  • Identify value engineering and design efficiency opportunities.
  • Coordinate early procurement of long-lead and engineered equipment.
  • Lead formal project handovers from pre-construction into operational delivery teams.
  • Coordinate early design engagement with clients and internal design teams.
Project Delivery Support
  • Maintain involvement through early design and procurement stages.
  • Support project teams during the transition into construction.
  • Drive lessons learned and continuous improvement across project delivery.
Leadership & Process Improvement
  • Improve pre-construction processes, systems, templates and reporting.
  • Maintain accurate records across estimates, budgets and handover documentation.
  • Provide reporting on pipeline opportunities, project handovers and key lessons learned.
  • Play a key role in developing the future pre-construction function, with the opportunity to build and lead a team.
About You
We are looking for someone with a strong understanding of the construction lifecycle and the ability to bridge the gap between winning work and successfully delivering it.
You may currently be working as a:
  • Pre-Construction Manager
  • Senior Project Manager
  • Project Manager with strong estimating experience
  • Senior Estimator looking to move closer to project strategy and delivery
  • Electrical or Building Services Engineer with significant commercial project experience
Ideally, you will bring:
  • Experience in project management and/or engineering combined with estimating experience within the construction industry.
  • A strong understanding of buildability, constructability and design review.
  • Experience across the full project lifecycle, from ECI and tender through to design, procurement and project handover.
  • The ability to review complex scopes and identify commercial, technical and delivery risks.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work across estimating, design, operations and client teams.
  • Experience identifying value engineering and design efficiency opportunities.
  • Excellent analytical, commercial and problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience within electrical services, building services, industrial construction, infrastructure or mission-critical/data centre environments will be highly regarded.
 
What's On Offer?
This is a genuine opportunity to take ownership of a critical function within a growing contractor.
You will have:
  • A highly influential role across major projects.
  • Package: $180,000 - $220,000 + super + vehicle/car allowance (DOE)
  • Exposure to projects from tender through to delivery.
  • The opportunity to shape and improve pre-construction processes.
  • Close collaboration with senior leadership.
  • A clear pathway into building and leading a dedicated pre-construction team.
  • A strong pipeline of complex electrical and infrastructure projects.
  • A permanent, long-term career opportunity with a growing Melbourne-based contractor.
Apply
If you are an experienced construction professional looking to move into a strategic pre-construction leadership role, we'd like to hear from you.
For a confidential discussion, please contact Connor Gwilliam at Design & Build Recruitment, or apply directly via the link below.
All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

job.title: Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Maintenance Technician — Sterile Injectables

Location: Chatswood, NSW
Industry: Pharmaceutical Manufacturing (Sterile Injectables)
Hours: Monday–Friday, 8am–4pm (training period), transitioning to rotating 8am–4pm / 7am–3pm shifts
Salary: $100,000–$115,000 + phone + discretionary bonus

 About the Company

Our client is an Australian-owned pharmaceutical manufacturer supplying hospitals nationally and exporting to international markets, with active plans for further global expansion. While smaller than the multinational giants, the business offers genuine access to senior leadership — including regular contact with the CEO — and continued investment in new machinery and cleanroom infrastructure.

This is a business with a strong retention track record: the maintenance team has very low turnover, with tenures ranging from 3 to 20+ years. You'll be joining a close-knit, growing team of 4.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on Maintenance Technician to join the site's maintenance team, working across cleanroom and aseptic suite environments supporting liquid filling and sterile injectable manufacturing. This is a step up for someone with tablet/solid-dose maintenance experience looking to move into liquid/sterile processing — or a great fit for someone already working in sterile injectables.

You'll partner closely with a senior technician during onboarding before moving onto the standard rotating roster.

Reporting to: Asset Manager (who reports to the Chief Operations Manager, then CEO)

Key Responsibilities

- Perform preventative maintenance on equipment, critical systems, and services — including purified water systems, cleanroom/aseptic suite systems, vision systems, blister and packaging equipment, and vial-based theatre pack lines (vials sterilised for direct use in operating theatres)
- Attend to breakdowns and troubleshoot faults across equipment, critical systems, and services, escalating to external contractors when a fault is beyond in-house scope
- Investigate and report breakdown root causes and concerns to management
- Ensure adherence to the preventative maintenance schedule
- Document all work and maintain accurate records in the CMMS within a cGMP-compliant change control environment
- Coordinate maintenance and repair activities with external service providers as required

What You'll Also Do

- Follow standard operating procedures in all work performed
- Complete GMP-standard documentation for work activities
- Contribute to the development of procedures and related documentation
- Support investigations into incidents, accidents, quality, and governance issues as needed
- Work collaboratively across Production, R&D, NPI, Validation, and QA/QC to support business objectives
- Identify, assess, and control workplace hazards and risks
- Report any accidents or incidents on the day they occur

 About You

- Mechanically minded, with proven maintenance technician experience in a regulated pharmaceutical environment
- Liquid filling / sterile injectable manufacturing experience strongly preferred; solid dose (tablet) experience will also be considered
- Food manufacturing background is not a fit for this role
- Working knowledge of CMMS platforms
- Exposure to equipment commissioning and validation processes
- Strong troubleshooting and fault-finding skills across mechanical, electrical, or utilities systems (purified water systems, vision systems, packaging lines)
- Comfortable working to GMP/cGMP standards and change control processes
- A collaborative approach and willingness to train and support colleagues
- Strong commitment to workplace health and safety
- No formal pharma qualification required — full training and support provided; the business will also consider candidates straight out of a mechanical apprenticeship


 Why Apply

- Direct, regular exposure to senior leadership including the CEO — a level of access not typical at larger multinational manufacturers
- Genuinely low staff turnover and a stable, tenured team culture
- Ongoing investment in new equipment and cleanroom upgrades
- Structured onboarding alongside a senior technician
- Company-supported training courses (up to $2,000) and career development, including pathways for apprentice-level candidates
- A growing, internationally expanding business with export markets beyond Australia

Interested in learning more? Apply now or reach out for a confidential conversation.
